core/winpath.py - Windows path helpers for reliable Excel file hyperlinks.

Excel's file:// URI handling is fragile with long paths, Unicode, spaces, and
especially the '#' character (which Excel treats as a sheet anchor even when
percent-encoded).  The Windows 8.3 short name is ASCII, has no spaces, and is
short enough to stay under Excel's URL limits, so we use it whenever possible.

Convert a local file path to a file:// URL that Excel can open.

    Uses the 8.3 short path when available; falls back to percent-encoding
    only '#' and spaces if short-path generation fails.
Return an Excel HYPERLINK formula string, or plain label if no path.
